title: The Cacophony Entity
description: A surreal dark painting depicts a towering amorphous entity composed of multiple distorted screaming faces and heads merging into one another. Long flowing tendrils of purple, black and red liquid-like forms extend from the central mass, dripping onto a dark abandoned office or classroom filled with scattered desks, chairs and papers.
prompt: A towering surreal horror entity made of multiple screaming and melting human faces fused together, with long flowing liquid-like tentacles in purple black and red stretching across a dark abandoned office room, papers and furniture scattered below, viscous drips falling from the mass onto the floor forming puddles, dark atmospheric lighting, grotesque and nightmarish surreal painting
